condition: in vivo chronic low back pain

source.authors: Ng JK-F, Richardson CA, Parnianpour M, Kippers V
source.sample: right-handed male chronic/recurrent LBP patients, pain-free or minimal pain at testing; LBP duration 6.0±4.4 yr

title: Normalised EMG of 12 trunk sites during R/L axial rotation at 30-100% MVC, standing, chronic LBP patients
subcategory: EMG at MVC and submaximal axial rotation

quantity.name: normalised RMS EMG
quantity.definition: RMS EMG over stable 3 s, baseline subtracted, normalised to the muscle's maximum EMG in any of the 6 MVCs

protocol.summary: Erect standing in a B200 Isostation triaxial dynamometer locked in 3 planes, L5-S1 interspinous space aligned with its flexion/extension axis; pelvis and lower legs stabilised (pelvic restraint, thigh and knee straps); torso fixed by chest restraint and thoracic pad; arms folded across chest. MVCs (5 s, randomised, 2 min rest) in flexion, extension, R/L lateral flexion, R/L axial rotation with visual feedback and verbal encouragement; then R/L axial rotation at 70, 50, 30% MVC to a visual target. Mean of stable 3 s; baseline (relaxed standing in device) subtracted. Same lab/protocol as Ng 2001. Surface electrodes bilaterally on 6 muscles parallel to fibres.
how_to_simulate: Upright standing, pelvis fixed, thorax restrained
Axial rotation right/left at 30, 50, 70, 100% axial MVC
Extract activations at RA, EO, IO, latissimus (T12), iliocostalis (L2), multifidus (L5), both sides; normalise by max over the 6 model MVCs
protocol.notes: sd null = error bar not visible (hidden by bar / < ~0.5%). Patients showed lower R and L rectus abdominis activity at high right-rotation levels and different R EO and L multifidus in left rotation.
